title: smfigapl setup
description: The setup of a tournament for the smfigapl game planner (YAML adapter, format_version 1). The output layout may be in the same text (see layout.schema.json). The planner checks the values itself (numbers of rounds, fields and clubs, names used in the conditions).

name.description: A name; a number is read as text.

format_version.description: The version of the format of the text (1).

iterations.description: How often a pairing may be played (with repeat_pairings).

repeat_pairings.description: Pairings may be played again, at most iterations times.

home_away_balance.description: Swap home and away so that every team has about as many of both.

optimize_round_order.description: Order the rounds so that no team pauses in two rounds in a row and no game repeats on a field in the next round.

fields.description: The fields in the order of the plan.

name.description: The name of the field in the plan.

type.description: The field type (for the field type conditions and the statistic).

subtype.description: The subtype (for the teams denied to it); fields of subtypes that no team shares form separate sub tournaments.

teams.description: The names of its teams (e.g. the colors of their shirts), unique within the club.

conditions.description: The conditions of the plan; a missing key means no condition.

max_pauses.description: The most rounds a team pauses.

max_same_club_games.description: The most games of a team against teams of its own club.

max_empty_fields.description: The most empty fields in a round.

field_types.description: Games per team on the fields of a type.

type.description: The field type (a type of the fields).

subtype_deny.description: Teams that may not play on the fields of a subtype.

subtype.description: The subtype (a subtype of the fields).

team.description: The name of the team within the club.
